objective: A1. Auditar exclusivamente en READ ONLY la base canonica EDARSAHUB para determinar que componentes debe REUTILIZAR, EXTENDER, CREAR o NO TOCAR ARBITROA antes de definir cualquier esquema fisico. Validar primero identidad SQL canonica DB_NAME()=EDARSAHUB, SUSER_SNAME()=HRLectura y USER_NAME()=HRLectura. Inventariar objetos relacionados con identidad/personas/RH, empresas/unidades, RBAC/menus/permisos, documentos/adjuntos, auditoria, notificaciones/comunicaciones, finanzas/pagos y cualquier dominio deportivo/arbitral preexistente. Prohibido DDL, DML, stored procedure execution, SQL dinamico, MongoDB, nuevas fuentes de verdad o cambios de Production.

queries.name: A1_00_CANONICAL_IDENTITY
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user;

queries.name: A1_01_RELEVANT_TABLE_INVENTORY
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS object_name, 'TABLE' AS object_type, t.create_date, t.modify_date FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Sistema%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empleado%' OR t.name LIKE '%RH%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE '%Adjunt%' OR t.name LIKE '%Archivo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Evidencia%' OR t.name LIKE '%Audit%' OR t.name LIKE '%Bitacora%' OR t.name LIKE '%Notific%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Mensaje%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Finanz%' OR t.name LIKE '%Banco%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cuenta%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name;

queries.name: A1_02_RELEVANT_VIEW_INVENTORY
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, v.name AS object_name, 'VIEW' AS object_type, v.create_date, v.modify_date FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id WHERE v.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR v.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR v.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR v.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR v.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR v.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR v.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR v.name LIKE '%Empleado%' OR v.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR v.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR v.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR v.name LIKE '%Audit%' OR v.name LIKE '%Bitacora%' OR v.name LIKE '%Notific%' OR v.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR v.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR v.name LIKE '%Finanz%' ORDER BY s.name,v.name;

queries.name: A1_03_RELEVANT_COLUMNS
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Sistema%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empleado%' OR t.name LIKE '%RH%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE '%Adjunt%' OR t.name LIKE '%Archivo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Evidencia%' OR t.name LIKE '%Audit%' OR t.name LIKE '%Bitacora%' OR t.name LIKE '%Notific%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Mensaje%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Finanz%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: A1_04_RELEVANT_FOREIGN_KEYS
queries.sql: SELECT schp.name AS parent_schema, tp.name AS parent_table, cp.name AS parent_column, fk.name AS fk_name, schr.name AS referenced_schema, tr.name AS referenced_table, cr.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc JOIN sys.foreign_keys fk ON fk.object_id=fkc.constraint_object_id JOIN sys.tables tp ON tp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schp ON schp.schema_id=tp.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cp ON cp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND cp.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables tr ON tr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schr ON schr.schema_id=tr.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cr ON cr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND cr.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE tp.name LIKE '%Sistema%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Empleado%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Notific%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Sistema%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Empleado%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Pago%' ORDER BY parent_schema,parent_table,fk_name,parent_column;

queries.name: A1_05_RBAC_MENU_EXACT_OBJECTS
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_Modulos','Sistema_ModulosMenus','Sistema_ModulosPermisos','Sistema_CatalogosPermisos','Sistema_RBAC_PerfilCatalogo','Usuario_RolesAsignacion','vw_Usuario_RolesContexto') ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: A1_06_SPORTS_DOMAIN_COLLISION_SCAN
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Arbitr%' OR o.name LIKE '%Liga%' OR o.name LIKE '%Torneo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Jornada%' OR o.name LIKE '%Partido%' OR o.name LIKE '%Jugador%' OR o.name LIKE '%Equipo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Deport%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cedula%' OR o.name LIKE '%Sancion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Veto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Geofence%' OR o.name LIKE '%Geo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Safety%' OR o.name LIKE '%ProteccionCivil%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name;

queries.name: A1_07_ROWCOUNT_SIGNAL_RELEVANT_TABLES
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.index_id IN (0,1) THEN p.rows ELSE 0 END) AS approx_rows FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empleado%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE '%Notific%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR t.name LIKE '%Finanz%' GROUP BY s.name,t.name ORDER BY s.name,t.name;

queries.name: A1_08_KEY_INDEX_SIGNAL
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.is_primary_key, i.is_unique, STRING_AGG(c.name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal) AS key_columns FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id AND i.index_id>0 JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id AND ic.key_ordinal>0 JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empleado%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE '%Pago%' GROUP BY s.name,t.name,i.name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique ORDER BY s.name,t.name,i.is_primary_key DESC,i.is_unique DESC,i.name;

queries.name: A1_09_PROCEDURE_AND_FUNCTION_SIGNAL
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND o.type IN ('P','FN','IF','TF') AND (o.name LIKE '%RBAC%' OR o.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR o.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR o.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR o.name LIKE '%Audit%' OR o.name LIKE '%Notific%' OR o.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR o.name LIKE '%Pago%' OR o.name LIKE '%Finanz%' OR o.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR o.name LIKE '%Empleado%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name;
